annotations.title: One composed document for an area

description:
The market for one area, as one document: sourcing readiness per strategy
    from the coverage register, the commercial capital and rent indices with
    rated stock, the planning decision record for the authority, and the live
    listing stock.

    THE TWO SCOPES ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. Readiness, commercial stock and the
    planning register are keyed on the LOCAL AUTHORITY (`lad_code`, a GSS code
    — use `area_resolve` to get one); the live listing lane is keyed on
    POSTCODE DISTRICT. Pass both to fill every section, and expect the
    unsupplied half to read `not_available` with that reason rather than empty.

    As with `property_report`, check `sections_degraded` before describing the
    document as complete.
    UK only. Costs 25 credits (25p).
name: area_report
